name: menubar
title: Menubar 菜单栏
description: 桌面应用风格的常驻菜单栏，集中提供文件、编辑、视图等命令。

whenToUse: 编辑器、工具类应用顶部常驻的一组命令菜单
命令带复选项、单选项、子菜单或快捷键提示

whenNotToUse.case: 网站页面之间的导航链接
单个按钮触发的少量操作

accessibility: 保留 Bits UI 的键盘操作：左右键在菜单间切换，上下键选择，Esc 关闭
Menubar.Shortcut 只显示快捷键，快捷键本身需另行实现
responsive: 菜单横向排列，窄屏空间有限，菜单数量要少，否则改用 dropdown-menu
菜单内容靠近边缘时自动调整位置

# Menubar 设计规范

- 只用于桌面应用式界面（编辑器、设计工具）顶部常驻的“文件／编辑／视图”菜单；网站导航用 Navigation Menu，单个按钮的操作菜单用 Dropdown Menu。
- 菜单栏在窄屏下不会自动折叠；移动端改用 Dropdown Menu 或 Sheet 提供同样的操作。
- 菜单项写法与 Dropdown Menu 相同：操作用 `onSelect`，危险项设 `variant="destructive"`，可勾选项用 `CheckboxItem`、`RadioItem`。
- `Menubar.Shortcut` 显示的快捷键必须真正实现，并与系统和浏览器的常用快捷键不冲突。

"open" : "closed", ...refAttachment, }} {#if child} {@render child({ props: attributes, open: state.open })} {:else}

<script lang="ts">
	import {
		Menu as SdkMenu,
		type MenuController,
		type MenuOpenChangeReason,
	} from "@ui-sdk/svelte/menu";
	import type { ChangeDetails } from "@ui-sdk/core";
	import { getContext, setContext, type Snippet } from "svelte";
	import {
		MENUBAR_POLICY_KEY,
		MENUBAR_VALUE_KEY,
		type MenubarDismissPolicy,
		type MenubarValueContext,
	} from "./context.js";

	const PARENT_ESCAPE_KEY = Symbol.for("valar-dialog-parent-escape");

	let {
		value,
		open = $bindable(),
		defaultOpen,
		modal: modalProp,
		loop,
		delay,
		controller,
		container,
		onOpenChange,
		onOpenChangeComplete,
		children,
	}: {
		value?: string;
		open?: boolean;
		defaultOpen?: boolean;
		modal?: boolean | "pointer";
		loop?: boolean;
		delay?: number;
		controller?: MenuController<unknown>;
		container?: Element | DocumentFragment | null;
		onOpenChange?: (open: boolean, details?: ChangeDetails<MenuOpenChangeReason>) => void;
		onOpenChangeComplete?: (open: boolean) => void;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	const generatedValue = $props.id();
	const menuValue = $derived(value ?? generatedValue);
	const bar = getContext<MenubarValueContext | undefined>(MENUBAR_VALUE_KEY);
	const parentEscape = getContext<(() => void) | undefined>(PARENT_ESCAPE_KEY);

	let policy = $state<MenubarDismissPolicy>({});
	setContext(MENUBAR_POLICY_KEY, {
		set(next: MenubarDismissPolicy) {
			policy = next;
		},
	});

	const resolvedModal = $derived(
		modalProp ??
			(policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "ignore" ||
			policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore"
				? false
				: undefined)
	);

	const controlledOpen = $derived(
		open !== undefined
			? open
			: bar?.isControlled
				? bar.value === menuValue
				: undefined
	);

	function handleOpenChange(next: boolean, details: ChangeDetails<MenuOpenChangeReason>) {
		if (!next) {
			if (
				(details.reason === "outside-press" ||
					details.reason === "focus-out" ||
					details.reason === "window-blur") &&
				(policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "ignore" ||
					policy.interactOutsideBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore")
			) {
				details.cancel();
				return;
			}
			if (
				details.reason === "escape-key" &&
				(policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "ignore" ||
					policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore")
			) {
				details.cancel();
				if (policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore") {
					parentEscape?.();
				}
				return;
			}
			if (details.reason === "outside-press" && policy.onInteractOutside) {
				const event = new CustomEvent("interactOutside", {
					cancelable: true,
					detail: { originalEvent: details.event },
				});
				policy.onInteractOutside(event);
				if (event.defaultPrevented) {
					details.cancel();
					return;
				}
			}
			if (details.reason === "escape-key" && policy.onEscapeKeydown) {
				const event = new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Escape", cancelable: true });
				policy.onEscapeKeydown(event);
				if (event.defaultPrevented) {
					details.cancel();
					return;
				}
			}
		}
		onOpenChange?.(next, details);
		if (!details.canceled) {
			if (open !== undefined) open = next;
			bar?.onMenuOpenChange(menuValue, next);
			if (!next && details.reason === "escape-key") {
				details.event?.stopPropagation();
			}
		}
	}
</script>

<SdkMenu
	open={controlledOpen}
	{defaultOpen}
	modal={resolvedModal}
	{loop}
	{delay}
	presentation="popover"
	{controller}
	{container}
	onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}
	{onOpenChangeComplete}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</SdkMenu>

<script lang="ts">
	import type { Snippet } from "svelte";

	let {
		to: _to,
		disabled: _disabled,
		children,
	}: {
		to?: string | Element | DocumentFragment | null;
		disabled?: boolean;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();
</script>

{@render children?.()}

{#snippet render({ props })}
{@render children?.()}
{/snippet}

{#if state.checked} {/if} {@render childrenProp?.({ checked: state.checked })}
{/snippet}

{/snippet}

"right", "data-align": (props["data-align"] as string | undefined) ?? align, "data-state": state.open ? "open" : "closed", ...refAttachment, }} {#if child} {@render child({ props: attributes, open: state.open })} {:else}
{@render children?.()}
{/if} {/snippet}

{#snippet render({ props, state })} {@const attributes = { ...props, "data-slot": "menubar-sub-trigger", "data-inset": inset || undefined, "data-state": state.open ? "open" : "closed", ...refAttachment, }} {#if child} {@render child({ props: attributes })} {:else}
{@render children?.()}
{/if} {/snippet}

<script lang="ts">
	import {
		MenuSub as SdkSub,
		type MenuController,
		type MenuOpenChangeReason,
	} from "@ui-sdk/svelte/menu";
	import type { ChangeDetails } from "@ui-sdk/core";
	import { getContext, setContext, type Snippet } from "svelte";
	import { MENUBAR_SUB_POLICY_KEY, type MenubarDismissPolicy } from "./context.js";

	const PARENT_ESCAPE_KEY = Symbol.for("valar-dialog-parent-escape");

	let {
		open = $bindable(),
		defaultOpen,
		loop,
		delay,
		controller,
		onOpenChange,
		onOpenChangeComplete,
		children,
	}: {
		open?: boolean;
		defaultOpen?: boolean;
		loop?: boolean;
		delay?: number;
		controller?: MenuController<unknown>;
		onOpenChange?: (open: boolean, details?: ChangeDetails<MenuOpenChangeReason>) => void;
		onOpenChangeComplete?: (open: boolean) => void;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	let policy = $state<MenubarDismissPolicy>({});
	const parentEscape = getContext<(() => void) | undefined>(PARENT_ESCAPE_KEY);
	setContext(MENUBAR_SUB_POLICY_KEY, {
		set(next: MenubarDismissPolicy) {
			policy = next;
		},
	});

	function handleOpenChange(next: boolean, details: ChangeDetails<MenuOpenChangeReason>) {
		const isEscapeKey =
			details.reason === "escape-key" &&
			(!(details.event instanceof KeyboardEvent) || details.event.key === "Escape");
		if (!next) {
			if (
				isEscapeKey &&
				(policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "ignore" ||
					policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore")
			) {
				details.cancel();
				if (policy.escapeKeydownBehavior === "defer-otherwise-ignore") {
					parentEscape?.();
				}
				return;
			}
			if (isEscapeKey && policy.onEscapeKeydown) {
				const event = new KeyboardEvent("keydown", { key: "Escape", cancelable: true });
				policy.onEscapeKeydown(event);
				if (event.defaultPrevented) {
					details.cancel();
					return;
				}
			}
		}
		onOpenChange?.(next, details);
		if (!next && !details.canceled && details.reason === "escape-key") {
			details.event?.stopPropagation();
		}
	}
</script>

<SdkSub
	bind:open
	{defaultOpen}
	{loop}
	{delay}
	{controller}
	onOpenChange={handleOpenChange}
	{onOpenChangeComplete}
>
	{@render children?.()}
</SdkSub>

<script lang="ts">
	import { MenuTrigger as SdkTrigger } from "@ui-sdk/svelte/menu";
	import { cn } from "$UTILS$.js";
	import type { Snippet } from "svelte";
	import type { HTMLButtonAttributes } from "svelte/elements";
	import { bindElementRef } from "./context.js";

	let {
		ref = $bindable(null),
		class: className,
		disabled,
		focusableWhenDisabled,
		shortcut,
		child,
		children,
		...restProps
	}: Omit<HTMLButtonAttributes, "children" | "disabled"> & {
		ref?: HTMLElement | null;
		disabled?: boolean | null;
		focusableWhenDisabled?: boolean;
		shortcut?: string;
		child?: Snippet<[{ props: Record<string, unknown> }]>;
		children?: Snippet;
	} = $props();

	const refAttachment = bindElementRef<HTMLElement>((el) => {
		ref = el;
	});
</script>

<SdkTrigger
	disabled={disabled ?? undefined}
	{focusableWhenDisabled}
	{shortcut}
	class={cn("hover:bg-accent hover:text-foreground aria-expanded:bg-accent aria-expanded:text-foreground focus-visible:outline-1 focus-visible:-outline-offset-1 focus-visible:outline-ring rounded-sm px-1.5 py-[2px] text-[13px] font-medium transition-colors duration-150 motion-reduce:transition-none flex items-center outline-hidden select-none", className)}
	{...restProps}
>
	{#snippet render({ props, state })}
		{@const attributes = {
			...props,
			"data-slot": "menubar-trigger",
			"data-state": state.open ? "open" : "closed",
			...refAttachment,
		}}
		{#if child}
			{@render child({ props: attributes })}
		{:else}
			<button {...attributes}>{@render children?.()}</button>
		{/if}
	{/snippet}
</SdkTrigger>

{#snippet render({ props })}
{@render children?.()}
{/snippet}
